### A Prophet without Honor
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-prophet-without-honor
Passage: Mark 6:1-4
Points:
- Familiarity frequently tempts people to dismiss or undervalue the wisdom of those who are closest to them.
- Because Nazareth was a small village, the residents knew Jesus and His family as ordinary working-class neighbors.
- The locals recognized Jesus' extraordinary teaching and miracles but took offense because He had no formal rabbinic training.
- Rather than acknowledging God's hand in His wisdom, their pride caused them to stumble over His humble background.
- Persistent unbelief stems from a hard heart rather than a shortage of facts, requiring God's grace to convert a soul.

### Bible Pathways 10/22/2003
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-10-or-22-or-2003-1227772.html
Passage: Luke 4:16-30
Points:
- Jesus modeled the vital practice of regular corporate worship by faithfully attending the synagogue on the Sabbath.
- By reading from Isaiah 61, Jesus announced the fulfillment of messianic prophecy and presented the triune nature of God.
- Knowing Jesus only as Joseph's son, the listeners were startled and enraged by His claim to divine messiahship.
- Their hostility culminated in an attempt to execute Him by throwing Him off a cliff, but He walked away unharmed.
- Believers must test spiritual truths through daily examination of Scripture rather than acting on volatile human emotions.
